description: Host-routed deployment, so area-to-area traffic is visible to the engine. The accompanying policy (case03_overbroad_interarea.acl) has an overly broad permit between Intake and Filtration; this evidence shows a PLC in one area reachable from a PLC in the other on a protocol (SMB) that has no operational reason to cross that boundary, demonstrating the rule is not just present but usable for lateral movement.

flows.notes: PLANTED VIOLATION: Intake PLC-1 reaching Filtration PLC-2 on SMB, a protocol neither area's operational traffic uses. Explained only by the overbroad permit ip 10.12.0.0/24 10.13.0.0/24 rule; no operational justification for this path exists in the topology.
